role_meaning.Pi: Source 4 categorical instructed visual events/key labels, measured context/suffix length partitions; suffix hierarchy is a predictor representation not inferred hierarchical supervisor.
role_meaning.X: Hypothetical ddHDP timestamped context-labelled hierarchical customer seating c, decaying weighted counts, level-specific strengths alpha and decays lambda. Trial-wise external sequence is not automatically participant internal state.
role_meaning.C: Source-supported valid categorical probability simplexes, 1/L no-context base, fixed finite N level depth and per-fitting explicit hyperparameter support in publisher S1 Table. External task phase conditions stay L_ctx not arbitrary realizability C.
role_meaning.Q: The original model's context-conditioned categorical predictive distribution and original recency/strength weighted criteria. Author RT-MAP fit and statistical significance are EXTERNAL EXPERIMENT analyses, not internal participant Q.
role_meaning.P_in: Exogenous trial t instructed cue e_t enters originally posited source learner; S1 ADD_CUSTOMER uses e_t even when observed participant response k_t is wrong.
role_meaning.P_out: CUSTOMER_PROB gives predicted distribution over k_t read without writing old seats; distinguish observed manual key press from model query.
role_meaning.K: Source-original recursive ddHDP prediction and original separate ADD_CUSTOMER timestamped sample insertion/stochastic lower suffix update. Do NOT count analyst MAP fit or hypothetical dual-HCRP future arbiter as participant original learning operator.
role_meaning.T: Source trial succession, previous-event suffixes of bounded depth, exponential temporal weighting, session epoch old/new changes and long-range retained decaying events.
role_meaning.rho/O: Experiment observation of participant's k_t, RT, errors, 24-comparison BH results, model-data discrepancies; model inferred hidden seating never a directly measured brain trace.

System_World_Experiment.System: Alternative computational hypothetical ORIGINAL P19 internal single ddHCRP seating state c, conditional predictive sampler and label update. Human correspondence remains inference only; no autonomous motor skill executor, no novel coordinator.
System_World_Experiment.World: Researcher imposed ASRT visual cues, key mapping, alternating deterministic/random 8-event string, trial/task regime, old/new interference, instructed event e_t. Task schedule is external.
System_World_Experiment.Experiment: Observed participant key k_t, latency RT, experimenter sampling five seatings, 1000x10 ABC alpha/lambda draws and OLS rho, fitted truncated session priors, author figure comparisons and model alternatives; original human statistical reports not W4 replicated.
System_World_Experiment.boundary: Exogenous instructed e_t enters via P_in; source abstract model outputs p(k_t) via P_out; observed actual key/RT are rho/O; distinct experimenter fitted model from demonstrated human brain.
